[[Shen's Censure]] is a [[Unique item|unique]] [[focus]] dropped by [[Quufu]] and [[Shen, the Magistrate]], [[boss]]es in [[Wajjun Bazaar]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Smiting Prayers]])
:[[Smiting Prayers]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:Halves skill recharge of [[Smiting Prayers]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Hallowed Idol]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it has the properties of two inscriptions, 'Forget Me Not' and 'Master of My Domain'.
